name: Bejaia

routes.outcome: Official Journal entry states that Béjaïa has a Wilaya cadastre directorate and places the Wilaya in the Sétif regional cadastre directorate area. This is local custodian evidence, not a public parcel API or geometry response.

Official Ministry of Justice map page was reachable through indexed rendering, but rendered content was generic ministry navigation and did not expose parcel layers, JavaScript configuration, API URLs, or safe parcel geometry.
Official French page was reachable through indexed rendering, but it contained generic ministry navigation and no cadastral parcel service or geometry.

Official ANFU site describes urban-land management, GIS, and dependencies on domain, cadastre, and land-registration data. It is general national-agency prose, not a Bejaia parcel viewer or local query service.

Official ASGA map search result describes a 1:200,000 general map viewer with boundaries, wilaya, communes, and thematic layers. Direct parcel layer or parcel geometry was not evidenced; bounded API inspection was not completed.

TLS verification failed because the local client could not validate the server certificate chain. No certificate exception was authorized or attempted, and no content from this failed request was used as evidence.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained; CRS and coordinate order remain unverified.

localCustodianAssessment: The official Journal entry directly evidences a Wilaya cadastre directorate for Béjaïa. The Ministry of Justice and ANFU pages are national/general service or agency evidence and were not treated as a local public parcel-map integration.

qualification.reason: No anonymous parcel geometry or city-bounded public vector response was verified; a serial reviewer must independently qualify any real adapter before runtime consideration.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved; no coordinate was shifted to force a hit.
No exact-point parcel hit or miss was used as a citywide absence claim.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon and native identity were obtained.

The official viewer route was only observed as generic ministry content through indexed rendering; current JavaScript/configuration, parcel API, schema, CRS, coverage, update cadence, and licensing remain unverified.
The direct client request encountered certificate-chain validation failure; no TLS bypass was used.
This packet records research completion only and is not source integration, admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: A local cadastre custodian is evidenced, but anonymous parcel-service reachability, viewer/API configuration, parcel schema/CRS, city coverage, update cadence, licensing, and runtime behavior remain unverified. The lack of public geometry is an access/discovery limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
